purpose: Verify patient can access the static weekly doctor schedule and current-day real-time attendance status
preconditions: Doctor schedule exists and is published; attendance for today is recorded
action_or_input: Patient requests doctor availability
expected_result: Master schedule and current-day live attendance status are returned together

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can maintain/update an existing static weekly schedule of visiting doctors
preconditions: A doctor schedule exists and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff submits updated schedule details including timing, room, and visiting days
expected_result: Schedule is updated and persisted with the new details

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can mark a visiting doctor as Available in real time
preconditions: Doctor is on schedule and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks doctor status as Available
expected_result: Doctor real-time attendance status is updated to Available and persisted

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can mark a visiting doctor as Departed in real time
preconditions: Doctor is currently marked Available and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks doctor status as Departed
expected_result: Doctor real-time attendance status is updated to Departed

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can create a doctor schedule
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates a doctor schedule with doctor name, specialization, visiting days, and time slots
expected_result: Doctor schedule is created successfully

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can publish a doctor schedule for patient visibility
preconditions: Doctor schedule has been created and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff publishes the schedule
expected_result: Schedule status becomes published and is visible to patients

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can search for a patient profile
preconditions: Patient profiles exist in the system and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff searches by patient identifier or name
expected_result: Matching patient profile is returned to PHC Staff

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can create a patient visit record
preconditions: Patient profile exists and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff records a visit with patient identifier, visit date, doctor, symptoms, and diagnosis
expected_result: Visit record is created and linked to the patient profile

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can digitize a physical prescription and link it to patient record
preconditions: Patient visit record exists and user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates a prescription with medicine details, dosage, and instructions linked to patient record
expected_result: Prescription is stored and linked to the corresponding patient record

purpose: Verify patient has read-only access to their own medical history
preconditions: Patient has existing visit records
action_or_input: Patient requests their own medical history
expected_result: Patient's own medical history is returned in read-only mode

purpose: Verify patient can access prescriptions associated with their own medical history
preconditions: Prescriptions exist for the authenticated patient
action_or_input: Patient requests prescriptions linked to their records
expected_result: Prescriptions belonging to the patient are returned

purpose: Verify patient can download PDF copies of their own medical records
preconditions: Patient has medical visit/prescription records
action_or_input: Patient requests PDF download for their medical record
expected_result: A valid PDF document containing the patient's record is generated and returned

purpose: Verify cross-patient medical data access is prevented
preconditions: Patient A and Patient B exist with separate medical records
action_or_input: Patient A attempts to access Patient B's medical records or prescriptions
expected_result: Access is denied with 403 Forbidden without disclosing Patient B's records

purpose: Verify institute employee is permitted to initiate a reimbursement claim
preconditions: User is authenticated with Employee role
action_or_input: Employee initiates reimbursement claim submission
expected_result: Claim submission is allowed to proceed

purpose: Verify students are excluded from submitting reimbursement claims
preconditions: User is authenticated with Student role
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit a reimbursement claim
expected_result: Reimbursement submission is rejected with an eligibility error or 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim requires a valid recorded prescription for the claimant
preconditions: Employee attempts to submit a claim without linking a valid prescription belonging to claimant
action_or_input: Employee submits reimbursement claim with non-existent or invalid prescription ID
expected_result: Claim is rejected due to missing or invalid prescription prerequisite

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim within configured submission window is accepted
preconditions: Employee has valid prescription with expense date within configured submission window
action_or_input: Employee submits reimbursement claim for expense within window
expected_result: Claim submission window validation succeeds

purpose: Verify reimbursement claim outside configured submission window is rejected
preconditions: Expense date exceeds the configured submission window
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit reimbursement claim for expired expense date
expected_result: Claim submission is rejected for exceeding allowable submission window

purpose: Verify eligible employee successfully submits reimbursement claim creating an active claim in initial state
preconditions: Employee with valid prescription and expense date within window
action_or_input: Employee submits complete reimbursement claim
expected_result: Claim is created and enters initial review stage (SUBMITTED)

purpose: Verify sequential progression of reimbursement workflow across all mandatory stages
preconditions: Claim is submitted by eligible employee
action_or_input: Claim moves sequentially through PHC Staff review, Accounts & Audit verification, Approving Authority sanction, and Accounts & Audit payment
expected_result: Stages transition strictly in order: SUBMITTED -> PHC_REVIEWED -> ACCOUNTS_VERIFIED -> SANCTIONED -> PAID

purpose: Verify PHC Staff reviews submitted claim and forwards to Accounts & Audit
preconditions: Claim is in SUBMITTED state; user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff reviews and approves forward progression
expected_result: Claim advances to PHC_REVIEWED stage / forwarded to Accounts & Audit

purpose: Verify Accounts & Audit verifies financial details and forwards claim for sanction
preconditions: Claim is in PHC_REVIEWED state; user has Accounts & Audit role
action_or_input: Accounts & Audit records financial verification
expected_result: Claim advances to ACCOUNTS_VERIFIED stage / forwarded for sanction

purpose: Verify Approving Authority approves reimbursement sanction
preconditions: Claim is in ACCOUNTS_VERIFIED state; user has Approving Authority role
action_or_input: Approving Authority approves sanction
expected_result: Claim status updates to SANCTIONED (or APPROVED)

purpose: Verify Approving Authority rejects reimbursement sanction terminating the claim
preconditions: Claim is in ACCOUNTS_VERIFIED state; user has Approving Authority role
action_or_input: Approving Authority rejects sanction
expected_result: Claim status updates to REJECTED and claim reaches a terminal state

purpose: Verify Accounts & Audit processes payment for approved claim closing it as reimbursed
preconditions: Claim is in SANCTIONED state; user has Accounts & Audit role
action_or_input: Accounts & Audit processes final payment
expected_result: Claim status updates to PAID / REIMBURSED and workflow terminates

purpose: Verify employee can view status and action history of their own reimbursement claims
preconditions: Employee has submitted one or more reimbursement claims
action_or_input: Employee queries their claim history and status
expected_result: Current workflow stage and action history of employee's claims are displayed

purpose: Verify claimant receives notifications on claim status changes including rejection and payment
preconditions: Claim exists for employee
action_or_input: Claim transitions status (e.g. rejected or payment processed)
expected_result: Notification is generated and delivered to the claimant

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can add to and deduct from inventory stock levels
preconditions: Inventory item exists; user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff adjusts stock (adds quantity, then deducts quantity)
expected_result: Stock level reflects the adjustments correctly

purpose: Verify system compares updated stock level against item reorder threshold
preconditions: Item has configured reorder threshold
action_or_input: Stock level is updated
expected_result: System evaluates remaining stock against threshold

purpose: Verify low-stock warning is generated for PHC Staff when stock falls below reorder threshold
preconditions: Inventory item has reorder threshold of 20 and current stock 25
action_or_input: Stock is deducted by 10 resulting in stock 15 (below threshold 20)
expected_result: Low-stock warning notification is created for PHC Staff

purpose: Verify no low-stock warning is generated when stock remains at or above reorder threshold
preconditions: Inventory item has reorder threshold of 20 and current stock 30
action_or_input: Stock is deducted by 5 resulting in stock 25 (above threshold 20)
expected_result: No low-stock warning notification is generated

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can create and submit an inventory procurement requisition
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff submits requisition with requested items and quantities
expected_result: Requisition is created in SUBMITTED / PENDING state

purpose: Verify submitted inventory requisition is routed to Approving Authority
preconditions: Requisition has been submitted by PHC Staff
action_or_input: System routes requisition for decision
expected_result: Requisition is accessible to Approving Authority for decision

purpose: Verify Approving Authority approves pending inventory requisition
preconditions: Requisition is pending; user has Approving Authority role
action_or_input: Approving Authority approves requisition
expected_result: Requisition status becomes APPROVED

purpose: Verify Approving Authority rejects pending inventory requisition
preconditions: Requisition is pending; user has Approving Authority role
action_or_input: Approving Authority rejects requisition
expected_result: Requisition status becomes REJECTED

purpose: Verify originator PHC Staff is notified when requisition is approved or rejected
preconditions: Requisition submitted by PHC Staff member
action_or_input: Approving Authority decides requisition (Approved or Rejected)
expected_result: Decision notification is generated for the originating PHC Staff member

purpose: Verify PHC Staff marks approved requisition as Fulfilled after delivery without auto-altering stock
preconditions: Requisition is in APPROVED state; supplies delivered; user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks requisition as Fulfilled
expected_result: Requisition status is FULFILLED; inventory quantities are unchanged until explicit stock update

purpose: Verify PHC Staff records ambulance usage with timestamp, patient name, and destination
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff submits ambulance log with complete details (timestamp, patient name, destination)
expected_result: Ambulance log entry is created and persisted

purpose: Verify incomplete ambulance usage log is rejected
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff submits ambulance log missing required fields (e.g. empty patient name or destination)
expected_result: Log creation is rejected with validation error

purpose: Verify PHC Staff publishes health advisories visible to all patients on dashboard
preconditions: User has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff creates and publishes a health advisory
expected_result: Advisory is published and retrievable by patients

purpose: Verify PHC Staff can generate administrative reports across patient demographics, service utilization, and inventory consumption
preconditions: PHC data exists; user has PHC Staff role
action_or_input: PHC Staff requests demographic, utilization, and inventory reports
expected_result: Aggregate report data is returned for all three categories

purpose: Verify administrative reports anonymize patient data and protect PII
preconditions: Patient visits and demographics exist
action_or_input: PHC Staff generates administrative reports
expected_result: Report output contains no patient names, identifiers, or contact details

purpose: Verify access control enforces role-based restrictions across PHC functions
preconditions: User has Student or unauthorized role
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to access staff-only functions (e.g. adjust inventory or create schedule)
expected_result: Access is denied with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify immutable audit trail is recorded for sensitive operations on patient records, inventory, and reimbursement claims
preconditions: Authorized user performs action on patient record, inventory level, or claim status
action_or_input: A sensitive action successfully executes
expected_result: An audit log entry recording the action, actor, timestamp, and target entity is created and cannot be altered

purpose: Verify modifying or reopening a submitted or rejected claim is prohibited, requiring a new claim
preconditions: A claim has already been submitted or rejected
action_or_input: User attempts to edit or reopen the existing claim
expected_result: Edit or reopen request is rejected; existing claim remains immutable
